en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a two‑storey brick corner building with shuttered windows and a large tree in front. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Gambrinussäle in Marburg a. d. D." The front carries numerous handwritten notes and a purple business stamp. The reverse side is a German "Correspondenz‑Karte" with handwritten address lines, cancellation marks and the destination noted as Meran.
